fib: ______ are the conditions which must be satisfied at the interface where the two media meet.
boundary conditions
The boundary conditions are the conditions which must be satisfied at the interface where the two media meet.
______ is defined at the x = 0 end of the string.
tangent (or slope)
tangent
The tangent (or slope) is defined at the x = 0 end of the string.
______ is the ratio of the torque of a body rotating about a given axis to the angular acceleration about that axis.
moment of inertia
The moment of inertia is the ratio of the torque of a body rotating about a given axis to the angular acceleration about that axis.
______ is a rigid body capable of oscillating freely about a horizontal axis passing through it (Fig 1.9).
compound pendulum
Compound Pendulum A compound pendulum is a rigid body capable of oscillating freely about a horizontal axis passing through it (Fig 1.9).
